name: Groovy

identity.oneLiner: Late-1960s psychedelic print: interlocking contours, liquid lettering, flower-power forms.
identity.summary: Plum, raspberry, orange, marigold and teal flowing around cream organic panels. Sculpted controls and tightly fitted display type carry identity even in dense dashboards; ornament grows from the frame rather than floating as stickers.
identity.authenticityNotes: Continuous Bézier contour bands, asymmetric botanical lobes and compact cream lettering. No circular floral halos, hard offset stickers, copied artwork or words baked into SVG.

axes.shape: Sculpted cartouches and asymmetric organic panels
axes.ornament: Flowing bands and asymmetric flower-power stems
axes.motion: Static print; short state transitions; reduced-motion safe

bands.description: Quiet warm paper, small asymmetric corners, display headings and fine rules.
Sculpted controls, display lettering, single contours and restrained color. Alias: signature.
Full interlocking print field, cream display cartouches, nested contours and original botanical ornaments. Default when band is absent.

neverDo: Never use application-specific decorative CSS to rescue the Groovy identity.
Never bake heading words into artwork or reproduce reference artwork.
Keep display type off editable fields, table cells and small dense labels.
Never cover information, focus rings or hit targets with ornament.
No perfect circular floral halos, neon grids, sticker shadows or runtime network assets.
Keep native values and chart geometry accurate; decoration must not encode fabricated data.
